description:
[Merchant] **Replace** a product's delivery overrides. Whatever you do not send is removed, so read them first with `payware_products_get_delivery`.

**Endpoint:** PUT /products/{productId}/delivery

Each row is either `{"country":"RO","excluded":true}` (not delivered there; no surcharge) or `{"country":"BG","excluded":false,"surchargePerUnit":"3.00"}` (delivered, with an extra amount per unit in the product's currency). The product is useful here when it is shippable. Unknown product or one outside an ISV's shops: 404 `ERR_MISSING_PRODUCT`.

Needs a plan that can ship: Standard or Premium. A Basic (BSC) merchant is refused with 403 `ERR_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED_FOR_CURRENT_USER_PLAN`. Changes are audit-logged.

countries.description: The complete list of overrides, one row per country. Empty clears them

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, e.g. BG (accepted in any case, returned upper case)

excluded.description: true: this product is not delivered to this country (send no surchargePerUnit). false: it is, with the surcharge below

surchargePerUnit.description: With excluded false: extra delivery cost per unit in the product's currency, e.g. "3.00". 0 or more

productId.description: The product's ID: pr + 8 letters or digits, e.g. pr7e4rCToG

useSandbox.description: Use the sandbox (the default) rather than production

name: payware_products_set_delivery
